items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I witnessed a performance of Josephine Baker, when I was over in Denmark.

ctx.x: Well, I think -- I've always had the

opinion, and I think it's true, if you ever were something, particularly in Europe and overseas, you still are with those people. They're not fickle in their -- even though you haven't done anything for a long time, if you have done something that they acclaimed you for, they still do. I witnessed a performance of Josephine Baker, when I was over in Denmark. She was playing at the Tivoli in Copenhagen. And of course she was up there in years, and yet she -- while the performance was all right, I mean I can't see…
